title_zh: 全球健康与长寿每日简报
intro_zh: 每日汇总功能医学、长寿医学、精准营养、营养补剂与健康管理五大领域的中英文权威资讯，每条附原始出处链接。
intro_en: A daily digest of authoritative Chinese and international coverage across functional medicine, longevity medicine, precision nutrition, dietary supplements and health management — every item linked to its original source.

items.title_zh: 全国首个《口服肠道菌群移植（FMT）胶囊》团体标准发布实施
items.title_en: China's first group standard for oral FMT capsules officially released
items.summary_zh: 中国国际经济技术合作促进会正式发布全国首个口服FMT胶囊团体标准，南华大学附属南华医院为主要起草单位之一。标准从供体筛选与管理、菌群活性与纯度量化指标、质量控制与出厂检验，到包装、运输和贮存作出全链条规范，补齐口服FMT长期缺乏统一技术规范的行业短板，为肠菌移植的标准化推广与临床转化扫清关键障碍。
items.summary_en: China's first group standard for oral fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) capsules has been released, with Nanhua Hospital among the lead drafters. It sets end-to-end requirements covering donor screening, quantitative potency and purity indicators, quality control and factory testing, plus packaging, transport and storage — closing a long-standing standardization gap and clearing a key hurdle for the clinical rollout of oral FMT.

items.title_zh: 功能医学创新大会聚焦肠道微生态精准干预："测-补-养-固"闭环重塑代谢健康管理
items.title_en: Functional medicine conference spotlights precision gut-microbiome intervention
items.summary_zh: 功能医学创新大会官网发文指出，超七成国人存在不同程度的肠道健康问题，西湖大学与中山大学联合研究首次揭示2型糖尿病、高血压、血脂异常共享相似的菌群紊乱特征。文章梳理了功能医学"测补养固"四步闭环：先以宏基因组测序明确菌群图谱，再定制益生菌、益生元与后生元方案，并配合饮食与生活方式巩固，推动肠道干预从盲目调理走向精准纠偏。
items.summary_en: A feature from the Functional Medicine Innovation Conference notes that over 70% of Chinese adults have gut-health issues, and joint research by Westlake University and Sun Yat-sen University shows type 2 diabetes, hypertension and dyslipidemia share similar dysbiosis patterns. It outlines a four-step "test–supplement–nurture–consolidate" closed loop combining metagenomic sequencing with tailored pro-, pre- and postbiotics plus diet and lifestyle support.

items.title_zh: 医生提醒：肠-脑轴前景真实但需专业指导，精神益生菌与FMT不应自行尝试
items.title_en: Doctors urge caution on the gut-brain axis: psychobiotics and FMT need medical guidance
items.summary_zh: TopDoctor杂志刊文提醒，肠-脑轴研究升温的同时，商业菌群检测的方法学与临床价值差异巨大，经医生开具、由验证实验室完成的检测远比直接面向消费者的自测产品可靠。精神益生菌与粪菌移植在难治性抑郁、帕金森病等方向展现出真实潜力，但必须在医生指导下进行；自行处方高剂量益生菌既可能浪费金钱，也可能带来安全风险。
items.summary_en: TopDoctor Magazine cautions that commercial microbiome tests vary widely in methodology and clinical utility, and physician-ordered testing through validated labs is far more meaningful than direct-to-consumer kits. Psychobiotics and FMT show real promise for treatment-resistant depression and Parkinson's disease, but should only be pursued under medical supervision rather than self-prescribed.

items.title_zh: 英矽智能联合巴克研究所、哈佛医学院登Cell封面，开源AI长寿研究发现工具包
items.title_en: Insilico Medicine opens an AI longevity discovery toolkit on the cover of Cell
items.summary_zh: 9月17日，英矽智能联合Liquid AI、巴克衰老研究所、哈佛医学院及布莱根等机构在《Cell》发表封面研究，并同步开源一套AI长寿研究发现工具包。该工作将大模型与衰老生物学数据深度结合，用于加速衰老靶点与干预分子的发现，标志着头部AI制药企业正式把长寿科学列为重点方向，为全球抗衰药物研发提供可复用的开源基础设施。
items.summary_en: On September 17, Insilico Medicine, together with Liquid AI, the Buck Institute for Research on Aging and Harvard/Brigham researchers, published a Cell cover paper and open-sourced an AI longevity discovery toolkit. By pairing large models with aging-biology data to accelerate target and molecule discovery, the release marks a leading AI drug-discovery company formally committing to longevity science with reusable open infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 《自然·通讯》7500人研究：十种健康饮食模式均与更慢的表观遗传衰老相关，没有唯一"最优饮食"
items.title_en: Ten healthy diets all linked to slower epigenetic aging, Nature Communications study finds
items.source_zh: HealthDay／德国神经退行性疾病中心（DZNE）
items.summary_zh: 德国DZNE团队分析约7500名成年人的血液样本与饮食问卷，使用覆盖约85万个DNA位点的三代表观遗传时钟，评估地中海、DASH、MIND、北欧、植物基等10种健康饮食模式。结果显示任何一种高质量饮食均与更慢的生物衰老相关，且70%以上的受益通路在各饮食间共享；吸烟者从健康饮食中获益最大。研究者强调"不需要完美饮食，整体膳食质量才是关键"。
items.summary_en: A DZNE team analyzed blood samples and diet data from about 7,500 adults using epigenetic clocks covering ~850,000 DNA sites, assessing ten healthy patterns including Mediterranean, DASH, MIND and Nordic diets. Every high-quality diet was linked to slower biological aging, with over 70% of affected pathways shared across diets; smokers gained the most. "You don't need a perfect diet," researchers conclude.

items.title_zh: GeroScience汇总7项热量限制RCT：改善炎症-代谢衰老指标，约半数效应由减重介导
items.title_en: Pooled analysis of seven caloric-restriction trials shows improved aging biomarkers, half mediated by weight loss
items.summary_zh: 发表于《GeroScience》的汇总分析纳入7项随机对照热量限制试验、共829名平均约67.5岁的参与者。随机分配至热量限制组可显著改善由CRP、IL-6、胱抑素C、胰岛素、GDF-15等构成的复合炎症-代谢生物标志物指数；校正体重变化后效应量约减弱一半，中介分析提示约48.5%的效应由减重介导——"少吃"并非已被证明的抗衰老处方，仍需结合个体情况评估。
items.summary_en: A pooled analysis in GeroScience of seven randomized caloric-restriction trials (n=829, mean age ~67.5) found that CR improved a composite inflammation–metabolism biomarker index (CRP, IL-6, cystatin C, insulin, GDF-15 and more). Adjusting for weight change roughly halved the effect, and mediation analysis attributed about 48.5% of it to weight loss — "eating less" is not yet a proven anti-aging prescription.

items.title_zh: 《BMC Geriatrics》多中心RCT：12周含HIIT训练显著改善养老机构老人肌少症功能，握力平均提升9.1公斤
items.title_en: 12-week HIIT-based training markedly improves sarcopenia-related function in care-home residents
items.summary_zh: 发表于《BMC Geriatrics》的多中心随机对照试验纳入92名疑似肌少症的养老机构老年人。12周多组分训练（含高强度间歇）使握力较对照组平均提高9.11公斤、SPPB提高3.75分、起立行走测试改善7.09秒，握力与SPPB的NNT约为2，干预效率罕见地高；但肌肉量未见显著差异，提示对高龄人群而言，功能改善优先于增肌数字。
items.summary_en: A multicenter RCT in BMC Geriatrics enrolled 92 care-home residents with probable sarcopenia. A 12-week multicomponent program including HIIT raised grip strength by 9.11 kg versus controls, improved SPPB by 3.75 points and chair-stand time by 7.09 seconds, with an NNT of about 2 — remarkably efficient. Muscle mass showed no significant change, suggesting functional gains precede hypertrophy in very old adults.

items.title_zh: 《低GI食品与健康消费产业共识（2026）》发布：低GI是膳食优化工具，不是"反碳水"口号
items.title_en: China releases 2026 industry consensus on low-GI foods as a dietary optimization tool
items.source_zh: 中国经济网（经Supwil每日文摘）
items.source_en: China Economic Net via Supwil Digest
items.summary_zh: 由农业农村部食物与营养发展研究所牵头、21家科研与产业机构专家参与制定的《低GI食品与健康消费产业共识（2026）》于9月20日发布。共识指出我国居民长期以精制谷物为主、慢释放碳水化合物摄入不足，餐后血糖波动推高代谢风险；低GI食品应在中国居民膳食指南的平衡框架内作为补充工具，同时纠正盲目断碳，倡导控制总量、合理搭配与个性化适配。
items.summary_en: The 2026 Low-GI Foods and Healthy Consumption Industry Consensus, led by China's Institute of Food and Nutrition Development with experts from 21 organizations, was released on September 20. It notes that refined-grain-heavy eating and insufficient slow-release carbohydrates drive post-meal glucose swings, positioning low-GI foods as a complement within balanced dietary guidelines while correcting blind carb avoidance in favor of portion control and food pairing.

items.title_zh: ScienceDaily：全谷物"甜蜜点"找到了——每天4-6份与更好的心脏健康相关
items.title_en: Scientists find the whole-grain "sweet spot" for heart health: 4–6 servings a day
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究为全谷物摄入划出了"甜蜜点"：每天约4-6份全谷物与更好的心血管健康指标相关，摄入不足则获益有限，盲目大量增加亦非更优选择。研究提示全谷物通过膳食纤维、B族维生素与多酚等成分的协同作用改善血脂与血管功能，为膳食指南中"粗细搭配"提供了剂量化的科学依据，也提醒公众优先用全谷物替换精制主食。
items.summary_en: New research identifies a whole-grain "sweet spot" of roughly 4–6 servings per day, associated with better cardiovascular health markers. Benefits taper off below that level, and simply adding more is not necessarily better. Fiber, B vitamins and polyphenols likely act together on lipids and vascular function, giving quantitative support for swapping refined staples for whole grains.

items.title_zh: ScienceDaily：8种常见食品添加剂与高血压、心脏病风险升高相关
items.title_en: Eight common food additives linked to high blood pressure and heart disease
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究将加工食品中常见的8种添加剂与高血压和心血管疾病风险联系起来。研究者指出，这些添加剂通常以"复合暴露"的形式被同时摄入，单一成分看似安全剂量的叠加效应可能被长期低估，提示超加工食品的心血管危害部分来自添加剂组合而非任何单一成分。这为"减盐减油减糖"之外进一步控制超加工食品摄入提供了新的循证支撑。
items.summary_en: A new study links eight additives commonly used in processed foods to higher risks of high blood pressure and cardiovascular disease. Because people typically consume them together as "co-exposures," the combined effect of individually safe doses may be underestimated, suggesting part of ultra-processed foods' cardiovascular harm comes from additive combinations rather than any single ingredient.

items.title_zh: 咖啡樱桃来源的非常规酵母展现益生菌与后生元潜力
items.title_en: Coffee cherry-derived non-conventional yeasts show probiotic and postbiotic potential
items.summary_zh: 据《NutraIngredients》报道，一项新研究从咖啡樱桃中分离出多种非常规酵母菌株，实验显示它们具备耐受胃肠消化、黏附肠道上皮等典型益生菌特性，其灭活后的后生元组分亦表现出抗氧化与调节潜力。研究为咖啡加工副产物的高值化利用开辟了新路径，也为功能食品行业提供了传统乳酸菌之外的新一代候选菌株资源。
items.summary_en: New research has isolated non-conventional yeast strains from coffee cherries that survive gastrointestinal digestion and adhere to intestinal epithelium — hallmark probiotic traits — while their heat-inactivated postbiotic fractions show antioxidant and modulatory potential. The work opens a high-value route for coffee processing by-products and adds novel candidate strains beyond traditional lactic acid bacteria.

items.title_zh: 蒙牛两款自研特医食品获批注册，均为国内首款符合新国标品类
items.title_en: Mengniu wins registration for two first-of-their-kind FSMP products in China
items.summary_zh: 蒙牛旗下特殊医学营养品牌"特一亿诺"宣布两款自研特医食品获国家市场监管总局批准注册：婴儿氨基酸配方"宁敏瑞"专为0-12月龄食物蛋白过敏婴儿打造，是国内首款符合特医食品新国标的该品类产品；谷氨酰胺组件配方"萱康安"亦为中国首款符合新国标的同类产品。"十五五"健康规划明确鼓励发展特医食品与保健食品，政策与供给端正同步提速。
items.summary_en: Mengniu's medical-nutrition brand has won registration for two self-developed foods for special medical purposes: an amino-acid formula for infants with food-protein allergy and a glutamine component formula, each the first of its kind under China's new FSMP national standards. The approvals follow the 15th Five-Year health plan's explicit encouragement of FSMP and health-food development.

items.title_zh: NYO3展出LPC系列脑营养新品：纳米级主动递送技术瞄准血脑屏障难题
items.title_en: NYO3 showcases LPC brain-nutrient line using nano-scale delivery to cross the blood-brain barrier
items.summary_zh: 2026服贸会期间，NYO3首次公开展出与Aker BioMarine合作的LPC系列脑营养新品。该系列采用LPC纳米级主动递送技术，相关原料拥有7国专利及多项国际安全认证，针对营养成分穿越血脑屏障的递送瓶颈，两款核心产品分别面向脑衰老干预与心脑肝协同养护场景，也反映出脑健康营养的市场竞争正从原料本身转向递送效率。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 CIFTIS, NYO3 publicly unveiled its LPC brain-nutrient line developed with Aker BioMarine. Built on LPC nano-scale active delivery technology with patents in seven countries, the products target the blood-brain-barrier bottleneck in nutrient delivery, with two SKUs aimed at brain aging and combined heart–brain–liver support — a sign that brain-health nutrition competition is shifting from ingredients to delivery efficiency.

items.title_zh: 美国新法案拟修复"药品排除"条款，为膳食补充剂创新松绑
items.title_en: New US bill seeks to fix the drug preclusion provision to boost supplement innovation
items.summary_zh: 美国一项新提出的法案试图修复膳食补充剂监管中的"药品排除"条款——当某种成分已被研究或获批为药物后，其补充剂形式可能被禁止上市，这一机制长期抑制行业对有前景成分的投入。法案希望通过界定触发条件与既有市场保护机制，在药品研发激励与补充剂可及性之间取得平衡，为补剂行业的成分创新扫清制度障碍。
items.summary_en: A newly introduced US bill aims to fix the drug preclusion provision in supplement regulation, under which an ingredient studied or approved as a drug can bar competing supplement forms from the market — a rule long blamed for chilling investment in promising compounds. The bill seeks to balance pharmaceutical R&D incentives with consumer access to supplements.

items.title_zh: FermBase推出发酵基生产调配物，为益生菌与后生元量产"提速降耗"
items.title_en: FermBase launches a blend to streamline fermentation-based production
items.summary_zh: 据NutraIngredients报道，发酵技术公司FermBase发布一款面向发酵基营养原料生产的即用型调配物，旨在简化菌株培养与放大流程、提高批次一致性并降低生产成本。随着后生元、发酵多酚与微生物来源功能原料的需求上升，产业界的注意力正从"筛选新菌株"延伸到"可规模化的生产工艺"，为精准营养产品的稳定供给提供支撑。
items.summary_en: Fermentation firm FermBase has launched a ready-to-use blend designed to streamline cultivation and scale-up for fermentation-derived nutraceutical production, improving batch consistency and cutting costs. As demand grows for postbiotics, fermented polyphenols and microbe-derived actives, the industry focus is expanding from strain discovery to scalable manufacturing.

items.title_zh: 玖治科技与瑞思迈战略合作：AI可穿戴戒指携手临床睡眠巨头打造"监测-干预"闭环
items.title_en: RingConn and ResMed partner to close the loop between wearable sleep tracking and clinical care
items.summary_zh: 据中国科学报报道，玖治科技（RingConn）与瑞思迈（ResMed）在上海签署战略合作备忘录，响应《国民健康"十五五"规划》增设睡眠健康门诊、推进数字化主动健康管理的部署。RingConn智能戒指负责心率、血氧与睡眠分期等无感数据采集，瑞思迈依托全球临床治疗与患者管理经验作为"服务出口"，用AI算法把连续监测转化为可执行的个性化睡眠管理建议。
items.summary_en: RingConn and ResMed have signed a strategic memorandum in Shanghai, aligned with China's 15th Five-Year national health plan push for sleep clinics and digital proactive health management. RingConn's smart ring feeds continuous heart-rate, blood-oxygen and sleep-stage data into ResMed's clinical expertise, with AI translating monitoring into actionable personalized sleep management.

items.title_zh: 全民健康文明生活方式宣传月：防慢病管体重，"主动健康、自我管理"成年度主题
items.title_en: China's national healthy-lifestyle awareness month puts self-managed health in the spotlight
items.summary_zh: 2026年9月1日是第20个"全民健康文明生活方式日"，本月宣传主题为"主动健康，自我管理"，围绕"饮食好、运动好、睡眠好"三好促健康，结合三减三健与儿童青少年"五健"科普展开。专家强调超重肥胖不只是外观问题，更是糖尿病、脂肪肝等代谢疾病的关键前置因素，体重管理应从依赖体检报告转向日常微小行为的早关注、早干预、早调整。
items.summary_en: September 1 marked China's 20th National Healthy Lifestyle Day, with this year's theme "proactive health, self-management" promoting good diet, exercise and sleep alongside salt, sugar and oil reduction campaigns. Experts stress that excess weight is a key precursor of diabetes and fatty liver, urging a shift from test-report dependence to early, everyday behavior adjustments.

items.title_zh: 央视网科普：科学评估健康体重不能只盯着体重秤，BMI、腰围、腰臀比要综合看
items.title_en: Don't just watch the scale: assess healthy weight with BMI, waist and waist-to-hip ratios
items.summary_zh: 央视网在"体重管理年"背景下刊发科普，指出单纯以体重数字判断胖瘦并不可靠：BMI需结合腰围与腰臀比综合评估，内脏脂肪堆积比体重数字更能预测代谢风险。科学的体重管理应聚焦腰围变化、体成分与生活方式质量，而非追求短期掉秤，为公众践行"健康体重管理行动"提供了可操作的方法论。
items.summary_en: In the context of China's "Weight Management Year" campaign, CCTV explains that body weight alone is an unreliable gauge: BMI should be interpreted together with waist circumference and waist-to-hip ratio, and visceral fat predicts metabolic risk better than scale weight. Sustainable management should track waistline, body composition and lifestyle quality rather than short-term weight loss.

items.title_zh: 43年、超13万人队列研究：每天2-3杯含咖啡因咖啡，痴呆风险降低18%
items.title_en: 43-year study of 130,000+: 2–3 cups of caffeinated coffee daily linked to 18% lower dementia risk
items.summary_zh: 哈佛大学与Mass General Brigham团队基于护士健康研究与健康专业人员随访研究，追踪超13万人长达43年发现：与极少饮用者相比，含咖啡因咖啡摄入量最高者痴呆风险降低18%，每天2-3杯含咖啡因咖啡或1-2杯茶获益最明显，且在痴呆遗传易感人群中同样成立；脱咖啡因咖啡未显示此类关联，提示咖啡因可能在保护效应中扮演关键角色。
items.summary_en: Drawing on the Nurses' Health Study and Health Professionals Follow-Up Study, Harvard and Mass General Brigham researchers tracked over 130,000 people for up to 43 years. Highest caffeinated-coffee intake was associated with an 18% lower dementia risk, peaking at 2–3 cups of coffee or 1–2 cups of tea daily and holding even in genetically susceptible groups; decaffeinated coffee showed no such link.
